name: code-kinds-e2e-fixture-generic-json-and-count-pin
body: The accessor e2e fixture parses generic JSON with hand-written record lines (matching the sibling code_universes test), so a future export wire-shape change is caught by the load/export e2e tier, not by this accessor test; and the map-length pin (6 then 3) assumes the fixture dir holds exactly one plan file. Limits: hand-written JSON lines and a hard-coded count pin. Upgrade: extend the fixture if the accessor starts reading additional fields, and add the count when the plan store gains other plans in this fixture.
